{{Historical article|update=0.13}} {{For|the island released in update 0.13|Crimson Isle}} {{Infobox/Location |title = Blazing Fortress |image = {{InfoboxGallery |image1 = Blazing Fortress.png|label1 = Island |image2 = Blazing Fortress (Top View).png|label2 = Top View }} |type = [[Combat]] location |travel_scroll = [[Travel Scroll to Blazing Fortress]]
[[Travel Scroll to Magma Fields]] |level = [[Combat]] Level V |fairy_souls = 19 |mobs = *Zombie Pigman *Blaze *Wither Skeleton *Magma Cube *Magma Cube Boss *Ghast |npcs = Elle of the Nether |drops = *Rotten Flesh *Gold Nugget *Gold Ingot *Flaming Sword *Magma Cream *Enchanted Magma Cream *Ember Fragment *Bone *Coal *Ghast Tear *Blaze Rod |resources = *Netherrack *Glowstone *Nether Quartz |prev_location = [[Spider's Den]] }} The '''Blazing Fortress''' was an island based around the [[mcw:The_Nether|Nether]]. It was accessed after the player has attained {{skill|combat}} Level V by using a launch pad found at {{Coordinates|-319|95|-314}} in the [[Spiders Den]]. However, you could still access a bit of the island by using an [[Aspect of the End]], [[Spider's Boots]], or a [[Grappling Hook]] through the void in the [[Deep Caverns|Deep Caverns,]] at {{Coordinates|-53|223|1}}. The area you can access is limited as you automatically warp back to the spawn of the Deep Caverns if you travel too far. The [[Crimson Isle]] replaced the Blazing Fortress in the Nether Update. A large variety of new, stronger mobs were added, and the island was expanded. The {{skl|combat}} level requirement is XXII (22). == Location == Inside the fortress itself, there were [[Nether Wart]], [[Blaze]]s, and [[Wither Skeleton|Wither Skeletons]]. Step 4 of the [[Romero and Juliette]] quest took place there, so [[Romero]] would be found here, where you had to bring him one [[Enchanted Red Mushroom Block]] to do the quest. The fortress also had a large courtyard behind it, connected by a bridge. Magma Cubes spawned on the bridge connecting the two parts. In the arena, larger, more dangerous Magma Cubes spawned. At nighttime, [[Ghast]]s would spawn very high in the sky. Every two hours, a [[Magma Cube Boss (Old)|Magma Boss]] would spawn which has a chance to drop the {{Epic}} or {{Legendary}} variant of the [[Magma Cube Pet]] to those who dealt the most damage to it. Outside of the fortress, there was a cave full of [[Glowstone]], [[Netherrack]], and [[Nether Quartz]]. The entrance in front of the cave was filled with [[Pigman|Zombie Pigmen]]. The cave ended with a view of the courtyard bridge. === Temperature === The '''Temperature''' was a mechanic in the [[Blazing Fortress]], which could be found by pressing tab. It was used to indicate when the next [[Magma Cube Boss]] was about to spawn. These were the temperatures that were known: {{Hl| *Warm *Tempered *Hot *Scolding *Volcanic }} {{ZoneText|Talk to &cElle of the Nether&f.|Battle against nether mobs.|Defeat the Magma Cube Boss.|Collect nether wart, blaze rods, and magma cream.}} == Trivia == *There was a flower pot located at {{Coordinates|-213|76|-480}} which served as a hint to players of a [[Fairy Soul]] below. *Another flower pot next to a [[Fairy Souls|Fairy Soul]] at {{Coordinates|-303|107|-691}} (via a tunnel starting at {{Coordinates|-301|107|-704}}). *The Blazing Fortress was actually a Desert Biome. *When viewed from the [[Spider's Den]], snow was on the roof of the fortress. *If you traveled to the Blazing Fortress without a launcher, I.E. using a grappling hook or an AOTE, part of the caves where you would mine [[Nether Quartz]] would be made of [[Sponge]]. *Traveling to the Blazing Fortress shortly after it was removed resulted in the message {{Red|There is a disturbance, this island has disappeared...}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/February 22|link=none|Replaced the '''Blazing Fortress''' with the [[Crimson Isle]].}} |beta= {{History|2019/June 11|Added '''Blazing Fortress'''.}} {{History|2021/August 24|Fixed the 'Collect Nether Wart and Blaze Rods' objective not completing in some cases}} {{History|0.13|Replaced the '''Blazing Fortress''' with the [[Crimson Isle]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}}
